summary: Constructor-style zero-initializer for a small tire-related state block: clears two byte fields (offsets 0x0 and 0x1) and six dword fields (offsets 0x4, 0x8, 0xC, 0x10, 0x14, 0x18), then returns 0. Invoked from tire-system construction, vehicle reset, and sub_4DFBB0.

operations.description: Zero the byte field at this+0x0.
Zero the byte field at this+0x1.
Zero the dword field at this+0x4.
Zero the dword field at this+0x8.
Zero the dword field at this+0xC.
Zero the dword field at this+0x10.
Zero the dword field at this+0x14.
Zero the dword field at this+0x18.
Called by PhysicsTireSystemConstructor (0x004E4500), VehicleResetClear (0x004E09E0) and sub_4DFBB0 (0x004DFBB0) to re-initialize the state block, placing it on tire-system and vehicle-reset paths.

unresolved: Semantics of each cleared field (the 2-byte prefix plus six dwords) are unknown; caller context only places the block on tire/vehicle-reset paths.
Identity of the owning class is unknown.
